evidence.statement: The keyed answers and explanations consistently match the supplied definitions of compute, storage, networking, App Services, Azure, and supporting AI-app infrastructure.

All items specify a deterministic correct answer or answer set, but items 10 and 13 include correct options that are near-paraphrases of the same networking or compute concept, weakening construct discrimination.

Most distractors represent credible category confusions, but item 10 has two correct options that are essentially equivalent and item 7 uses 'No application logic' as a negated non-need rather than a parallel service need.
Incorrect feedback diagnoses realistic confusions such as retention versus execution, connectivity versus storage, and hosting versus networking, especially in items 5, 10, 12, and 13.

The session moves from category recognition and definitions into application scenarios, but the Azure platform identification item appears after several category items and the later sequence revisits compute and networking, making the progression somewhat circular.
The session uses true/false, fill-in, arrangement, single-choice, and multi-choice mechanics, but begins with adjacent true/false items and repeats arrangement mechanics three times.
The question_text 'Arrange the pieces to form a correct statement.' is repeated verbatim in three ordered positions, creating a conspicuous formulaic pattern.
The retail image-storage, healthcare model, holiday order-processing, education web-app, and finance connectivity scenarios represent credible service-selection decisions.

Feedback generally identifies the governing distinction and gives a next-step rule, such as 'Compute runs the program; storage retains its data' and 'Networking handles secure communication; storage handles saved data.'
The Level 2 session appropriately starts with recognition and recall, then uses category-selection scenarios requiring basic application of the definitions.
The artifact consistently uses the source distinctions among compute, storage, networking, App Services, Azure, model, application logic, and user interface.

The 13-item sequence is source-faithful, ordered, varied in mechanic, and strongly supported by feedback, but repeated arrangement wording and near-duplicate correct choices reduce polish and discriminative value.

largest_gap.summary: Three arrange_sentence items use the identical prompt stem, making the session feel formulaic.

evidence.statement: Items 4, 8, and 11 all use the exact question_text 'Arrange the pieces to form a correct statement.'

largest_gap.repair_instruction: Revise only the question_text field on these three arrange_sentence items so each has a distinct, concise prompt while preserving every word bank, correct_order, answer, and explanation.

result.concise_summary: The artifact preserves identity, ordering, deterministic answers, source fidelity, and useful feedback. The main remaining issue is formulaic repeated arrangement wording, with secondary construct-discrimination concerns from near-duplicate correct options. Confidence is reduced because no approved references are supplied and validation feedback reports source-path citation mismatches.
